'''Eryk Chinn''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Shadow stormtrooper/Legends|shadow stormtrooper]] who served as a [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] in the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Stormtrooper Corps/Legends|Stormtrooper Corps]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. By the [[Time/Legends|time]] following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], Sergeant Chinn acted as the personal [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguard]] for [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Dac Axfow]], a paranoid [[Imperial officer/Legends|Imperial officer]] who feared uprisings from the populace. At one point, Sergeant Chinn accompanied Colonel Axfow and his personal [[TIE pilot|pilot]], [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Logro Elsin]], outside the [[Kor Vella Starport|starport]] in [[Kor Vella/Legends|Kor Vella]], a popular tourist [[City/Legends|city]] on the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core]] [[Planet/Legends|World]] of [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]].

==Biography==
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] by the name of Eryk Chinn served as a [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] in the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. As a member of the [[Stormtrooper Corps/Legends|Stormtrooper Corps]], Sergeant Chinn earned the distinction of becoming a [[Special forces/Legends|specialized]] [[Shadow stormtrooper/Legends|shadow stormtrooper]],<ref name="JTL" /> otherwise know as blackhole [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] due to their association with [[Agent/Legends|Agent]] [[Cronal|Blackhole]], [[Director of Imperial Intelligence]].<ref name="Imperial Handbook">''[[Star Wars: Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]''</ref> By the [[Time/Legends|time]] following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], Sergeant Chinn was assigned the responsibility of acting as a personal [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguard]] for a paranoid [[Imperial officer/Legends|Imperial officer]], a Human [[Colonel/Legends|colonel]] by the name of [[Dac Axfow]]. Fearing uprisings from the local populace, Colonel Axfow kept Sergeant Chinn, as well as his personal [[TIE pilot|pilot]], [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Logro Elsin]], nearby to handle any contingencies. Although Sergeant Chinn did not hold a high opinion of Colonel Axfow's sensibilities, he did not neglect his duties. At one point, Eryk Chinn and Logro Elsin accompanied their superior during a stay at [[Kor Vella/Legends|Kor Vella]], a popular tourist [[City/Legends|city]] on the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core]] [[Planet/Legends|World]] of [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]].<ref name="JTL" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided}}
While idling about outside the [[Kor Vella Starport]], Erykn Chinn respectfully turned away a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] approaching the trio, out of fear that the colonel may perceive the individual as a threat, and react unpredictably.<ref name="JTL" />

==Personality and traits==
Although he was assigned as a personal bodyguard to Colonel Dac Axfow, Eryk Chinn did not hesitate to openly criticize his superior. On one occasion, Sergeant Chinn admitted that Colonel Axfow was "short on common sense." Eryk Chinn, on the other hand, exercised restraint when it came to any potential threats. While guarding Colonel Axfow in Kor Vella, Eryk Chinn asked an approaching citizen to back away, out of a sense of duty to protect both the citizen and the unpredictably paranoid Imperial [[Officer/Legends|officer]].<ref name="JTL" />
{{Endgame}}

==Equipment==
While serving as a personal bodyguard for Colonel Axfow, Eryk Chinn wore black [[Color/Legends|colored]] [[Stormtrooper armor/Legends|stormtrooper armor]].<ref name="JTL" /> This [[Armor/Legends|armor]] was specifically worn by Imperial shadow stormtroopes, and it consisted of unique components, including a harder form of [[Duraplast/Legends|duraplast]] called [[Stygian-triprismatic polymer/Legends|stygian-triprismatic polymer]].<ref name="Imperial Handbook" />

==Behind the scenes==
Eryk Chinn was a non-player character included with [[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed|''Jump to Lightspeed'']], the [[2004]] [[W:c:swg:Expansion|expansion pack]] for [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Roleplaying game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="JTL" /><ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> In the [[Star Wars video games|game]], Eryk Chinn would simply stand alongside Dac Axfow and Logro Elsin in the [[W:c:swg:City|city]] of [[W:c:swg:Kor Vella|Kor Vella]] on the [[W:c:swg:Planet|planet]] [[W:c:swg:Corellia|Corellia]], and act as a type of "NPC greeter." Although he was added to [[W:c:swg:Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies'']] with the [[W:c:swg:Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed|''Jump to Lightspeed'']] expansion, it was still possible for players without the expansion to interact with the character. When examined, the description for Sergeant Eryk Chinn identified him as a "black hole stormtrooper."<ref name="JTL" />
